text: CHRIST UNIVERSITY Sidebar Campus News 25-4-2025 Call for Project Associate Position in ANRF (SERB) Funded Project This exhibition features the work of women who led printing houses in the sixteenth century, such as Charlotte Guillard, Yolande Bonhomme and Katherine Gerlach, as well as modern and contemporary printers and book artists, including Emily Faithfull, Virginia Woolf and Tia Blassingame. Visit the exhibition to learn the stories of women drawn to the printing professions, from its infancy in the early modern period to the present day.
